name: Weighted Chest Dip
steps: While standing, fasten the plate to a dip belt and check that its attachment is closed.
Take the dip handles and rise into a straight-arm support, keeping the plate still.
Lean slightly forward and bend your elbows to descend until your upper arms approach parallel without your shoulders rolling forward.
Press down to straighten your arms, then dismount under control before detaching the plate.
tips: Control the bottom of every repetition smoothly rather than dropping rapidly into the shoulder joints.
Avoid swinging the weight plate back and forth as you move up and down.
